title: Sagrada Família · Interior: el bosque cortado
description: docs/places/sagrada.md § The cut. Walking, the columns before and beside Gerard are stumps with their sections lit, and behind him each stands taller the further back it is, whole at the back; the overview grows them all back. Fran's salon standing, to see the queues, the mirrors and Fran from each zone. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Just in by the Nativity door: the reception desk, the arm's mouth, the crossing beyond
At the crossing: Fran on the presbytery, the queues to each side; stumps before Gerard, the columns rising step by step behind him
At the nave's mouth: the way into the nave, its mirrors and chairs
In the nave among the salon's chairs and mirrors
Up to the columns he was behind a moment ago: they have sunk to stumps, the far ones still whole
Before the presbytery: the chaplain, Fran under the canopy
Pulling back to the overview: every column grown up again
The overview (R): the whole forest and its vault, as before
